summary.zh: 文档站视觉与官网统一：改用官网 Command Luxe 深色设计语言（同画布色、奶油白文字、荧光绿强调、Fraunces/Inter/IBM Plex Mono 字体族），阅读体验与品牌一致性提升。
summary.en: Docs site visual language now matches the main site: same Command Luxe dark palette (canvas, cream text, lime accent, Fraunces/Inter/IBM Plex Mono type stack) for brand consistency.

highlights.zh: docs.modelswap.app 整体换装官网深色设计系统：同色画布与强调色、同字体族，标题衬线体 + 正文 Inter。
highlights.en: docs.modelswap.app adopts the main site dark design system: same canvas and accent colors, same type stack, serif headings + Inter body.

highlights.zh: 侧边栏/章节抽屉/翻页/表格/代码块/引用全部按新令牌重制，链接与当前章高亮使用官方荧光绿。
highlights.en: Sidebar, chapter drawer, pager, tables, code blocks and quotes restyled on the new tokens; links and the active chapter use the official lime accent.

highlights.zh: 窄屏章节抽屉样式同步换装，行为与断点不变。
highlights.en: The narrow-viewport chapter drawer follows the new look; behavior and breakpoints unchanged.
